course_description: This course deals with advanced game programming with a strong focus on developing good programming skills, design patterns, and practical problem-solving. The course will have a special provision on modality, pacing, pedagogy, assessment type, communication and feedback based on the national, regional, provincial, city, and institutional guidelines for the safety amidst disaster and pandemic. Hence, this class shall be delivered in both online and offline/module-based approach. This course is also compliant with Outcomes-Based Education (OBE) and 21st Century Learning Design (21CLD) frameworks.

course_learning_outcomes.text: Understand the structure of mobile game programming.
Remember the basic framework for mobile game development.
Understand how physics affects in development of the game.
Apply the design learned and report the expected effectiveness of the mobile game.

topic_learning_outcomes.text: Explain basic mobile game in a nutshell.
Apply key concepts of game processes, principles and ethics.
Detemine and generate mobile game programming.
Support observation to mobile game programming.
Classify the domain areas of mobile game programming.
